reviews.title: Stop with the subscriptions!!!
reviews.text: The free version is ok. You can count up or down. You can upload pics and I think set music (not sure who uses this feature but whatever). No widgets, lots of ads... but if you want to just pay for the app, it'd $14.99/year. That's obscenely greedy for such a basic app. A one-time fee of $5 would be the absolute most this is worth.  It's not the most intuitive app either.
